entry.k: A demon lord who trades favors for human souls
st: Mephistopheles sends his Ghost Rider to claim the contract of San Venganza, but the Rider flees with it.
He cures young Johnny Blaze's father of cancer for Johnny's soul, and the father then dies in a stunt crash.
Years later, he turns Johnny into the Ghost Rider and sends him to stop his rebel son, Blackheart.
With Blackheart beaten, he offers to lift the curse, but Johnny refuses and Mephistopheles vows to make him pay.
Posing as a man named Roarke, he hunts the boy Danny, his own son, to take over the boy's body in a ritual.
He brings Carrigan back as Blackout to seize Danny, but the Ghost Rider wrecks his car and drags him back to Hell.

entry.k: Mephistopheles' son, a demon loose on Earth
st: Blackheart comes to Earth and recruits the Hidden, three fallen angels, to find the lost contract of San Venganza.
His killings land Johnny Blaze in jail, then he kills Mack and takes Roxanne hostage to force a trade for the contract.
He absorbs a thousand souls as Legion, but Johnny's Penance Stare leaves him catatonic and his father takes his body.

entry.k: A fallen angel of the Hidden with power over earth
st: Gressil hunts for the contract with Blackheart, and the newly made Ghost Rider destroys him on his first night.

entry.k: A fallen angel of the Hidden with power over air
st: Abigor attacks while Johnny is held by the police, and the Ghost Rider destroys him before escaping.

entry.k: A fallen angel of the Hidden with power over water
st: Wallow ambushes the Ghost Rider at San Venganza and is destroyed before the trade with Blackheart.

entry.k: A mercenary hired by Roarke, and Nadya's ex
st: Carrigan seizes Nadya and Danny for Roarke, and his men drive off the Ghost Rider with grenades and keep the boy.
The Ghost Rider tears through his hideout with a giant mining machine and leaves Carrigan close to death.
Roarke revives him as Blackout, who rots whatever he touches, and he kills the monks to take Danny back.
He kills Moreau at the ritual, then dies at the Ghost Rider's hands in the chase that follows.

entry.k: The head monk of a remote monastery
st: Methodius decides the boy Danny must die and tries to kill him, but Blackout kills him and the other monks first.

entry.k: The demon called Mother, inside Victoria Helstrom
st: A demon called Mother, possessing Victoria Helstrom, overpowers Gabriella until Daimon and Hastings step in.
She tells Hastings her name is Kthara and that she gave Hastings her cancer.
Hiding from the Keeper, she takes back control of Victoria and carries off what is left of Spivey.
Ana frees Victoria, but Kthara jumps into Gabriella and has Basar take over Daimon's body.
She grows inside Gabriella in a pregnancy that races to term, and is born as a baby girl.
A month later, a man called Papa reminds her that her name is Lily and takes her away from Chris Yen.

entry.k: A demon wearing orderly Keith Spivey's body
st: After a raid on a demon's tomb, orderly Keith Spivey vanishes and, possessed, attacks a trucker on the road.
Aubree Richards lures Ana into a trap, but Spivey turns on Aubree and devours her.
He storms Saint Teresa's to take Victoria, until his body is burned away with the Keeper's skull.
Kthara keeps the demon Basar alive in Spivey's remains and has him take over Daimon's body.
Sealed in a cell, Basar breaks out in Daimon's body, but Ana and Yen tear him out and burn him for good.

entry.k: A demon that jumps from host to host
st: Magoth takes over trucker Alex Tilden, until Daimon drives him out to save Alex's soul.
He returns in a man named Bryce and attacks Daimon and Ana, who expel him again.
Riding Blood member Finn Miller, he joins Kthara's side, until Daimon kills him with the dagger and frees Finn.

entry.k: A demon possessing the priest Joshua Crow
st: Raum, inside Father Crow, attacks Gabriella, and the Caretaker subdues him and leaves him in the Blood's care.
He sides with Kthara, until Daimon kills him with the dagger and frees Father Crow.

entry.k: A secret order led by Esther Smith that holds the possessed
st: The Blood kidnap the Caretaker and call Daimon to a meeting, then attack him with a dagger.
Daimon burns several members alive and the rest flee.
At the old Helstrom house, he scares Esther's people but spares them and takes the other half of the dagger.
Shaken by what she has seen, Gabriella leaves the Helstroms to join the Blood.

entry.k: A twin who blames the Helstroms for her sister's scars
st: Aubree poses as her burned twin Zoe and lures Ana into a trap for revenge, but Spivey devours her.

entry.k: A mysterious man who calls Kthara by the name Lily
st: A man called Papa comes for the young Kthara, takes her from Chris Yen and kills innocents on the way out.
